summary: The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 2 hours.
body:
[Updated 11/4 at 4:54 PM PDT] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 2 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

We will be performing an unscheduled maintenance starting on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 3:00 PM PST (6:00 PM EST / 12:00 AM CET November 5 / 10:00 AM AEDT November 5). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 2 hours, concluding around 5:00 PM PST (8:00 PM EST / 2:00 AM CET November 5 / 12:00 PM AEDT November 5).

Times:

Wednesday, November 4, 2026
PST (UTC -8): 3:00 PM - 5:00 PM
EST (UTC -5): 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM
CET (UTC +1): 12:00 AM November 5 - 2:00 AM November 5
AEDT (UTC +11): 10:00 AM November 5 - 12:00 PM November 5

What will be unavailable:

  • All MapleStory Classic World game servers.

Changes and Updates:

  • Implemented improvements for bot detection and prevention systems.
  • Following a first-time NX purchase, Megaphones can no longer be used during the 96-hour Cash item trade restriction.
    • This applies to the Megaphone, Super Megaphone, Item Megaphone, and Double Item Megaphone.
    • The restriction applies to all characters on the account in that world, and is lifted when the trade restriction ends.
name: [Completed] Unscheduled Maintenance - November 4, 2026
